page: Microsoft Azure L16aos_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 AMD processor configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs. Compute resources are coupled with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no discrete GPU hardware accelerators.

The primary differentiator of the L16aos_v5 is its direct-attached storage subsystem, which features 11,519 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD capacity in addition to Premium Storage capabilities. This extensive local solid-state capacity eliminates reliance on remote block storage for primary data paths, offering low latency and direct bus bandwidth for I/O-dense workloads.

From a cost-efficiency and system architecture standpoint, pairing dense memory with over 11 TB of local NVMe capacity optimizes throughput per compute node for stateful applications. Network configurations should account for zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance architecture is best fit for large-scale NoSQL and relational database engines, real-time analytics, data warehousing, and transactional workloads demanding high local disk capacity.

This profile fits I/O-heavy production tasks, including transactional databases, distributed storage engines, big data analytics, and high-capacity caching layers that require significant memory alongside substantial low-latency local storage.
